hni_signals: Unusually heavily credentialled and dual-trained: MBBS Kurnool Medical College (2005), MD Radiation Oncology from PGIMER Chandigarh (2012), DM Medical Oncology from Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) Hyderabad (2019), plus MRCP SCE (UK) and ECMO (European Certified Medical Oncologist) - two international certifications on top of two Indian superspecialty degrees. Academic track record: Assistant Professor of Medical Oncology at NIMS Hyderabad (2022-2023), a government superspecialty institute, and prior service at MNJ Institute of Oncology, Hyderabad. Senior Consultant in Medical Oncology at CARE Hospitals Hyderabad (2023-2025) before moving to Yashoda, i.e. he has been recruited at senior grade by two of the city's large corporate groups in succession. Published in peer-reviewed journals including Annals of Oncology and Oral Oncology (work on squamous cell carcinoma and tumour markers). Member of the Association of Radiation Oncologists of India (AROI) and the Indian Association of Palliative Care (IAPC). Yashoda has produced a dedicated video playlist featuring him on its own YouTube channel, which the group reserves for consultants it actively markets.
